Method of Attack: Backdoor malware using payloads masquerading as a PDF decryption tool
Uses JSON over websockets to communicate with command-and-control server
Steals Chrome, Firefox, Opera, and Edge cookies
Establishes persistence using obfuscated PowerShell command creating a scheduled task
Impacted Systems: Windows devices (implied by PowerShell and scheduled task usage)
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with PDF documents appearing encrypted
Lure to download fake PDF decryptor executable (Proton-decrypter.exe)
Indicators of Compromise: Domains, websites, and files added to Google Safe Browsing phishing protection
